outcomes.title: A paper Monday drops

leadsTo.title: The Telephone for Calling Roads Not Taken

outcomes.why: A day arrives already annotated with someone else's plans for you, so the visitor is handed to the instrument that lets them ask a different version of themselves how those plans turned out.

outcomes.title: The machine keeps humming

leadsTo.title: The Umbrella That Remembers Every Storm

outcomes.why: The visitor has just kept a weekend for themselves, so the museum shows them the object built to store the shelter such weekends were spent under.

outcomes.title: A familiar stranger answers

leadsTo.title: The Umbrella That Remembers Every Storm

outcomes.why: A voice in an almost-familiar kitchen leaves the visitor holding a household they never lived in, and the umbrella is where this museum keeps the weather of households.

outcomes.title: A missed call arrives from you

leadsTo.title: The Vending Machine That Sells Extra Mondays

outcomes.why: The visitor now carries a date eleven years ahead that no calendar issued, and the vending machine is the only exhibit that sells dates the official year never entered.

outcomes.title: The room rains back

leadsTo.title: The Telephone for Calling Roads Not Taken

outcomes.why: Someone called the visitor indoors out of a storm that is no longer happening, and the telephone is the exhibit that answers voices like that one.

outcomes.title: The forecast forgets your name

leadsTo.title: The Vending Machine That Sells Extra Mondays

outcomes.why: Having been quietly removed from the weather's records, the visitor is walked to the machine that puts days back on a calendar for anyone willing to pay in plans.
